item.title: Fukui Family Trip: Dinosaur Museum, Beach Parks & Hands-On Crafts
item.description: Fukui Prefecture is quietly one of the best family destinations in Japan, and it has a secret weapon that children across the country are obsessed with: dinosaurs. Tucked into the mountains of central Fukui, Katsuyama city sits above one of the world’s richest fossil beds, and the museum built to honor those discoveries is genuinely world-class. Beyond the prehistoric, Fukui offers safe swimming beaches, scenic train rides, paper-making workshops, and a relaxed pace that makes Tokyo’s crowds feel like a different planet.
